title: Global Partnership Manager for Insurance
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€6.500,60 - €10.389,47
Are you driven by creating seamless customer experiences across borders? Do you thrive at the intersection of insurance product, technology, partnerships, and strategy? If you’re excited by the opportunity to build a market‑leading embedded insurance proposition used by millions of customers across multiple countries, this role is for you.
We’re embarking on one of our most ambitious cross‑market initiatives: delivering a unified Embedded Insurance experience across several countries. As ourGlobal Partnership Manager, you will lead the end‑to‑end implementation of this strategic program and shape the future of how customers engage with protection products in their everyday journeys.
Influence a high‑visibility, strategic, multi-country initiative.
Work in an environment that values innovation, customer focus, and continuous learning.
Collaborate with talented colleagues across markets and disciplines.
Help shape the future of embedded insurance and protection for millions of customers.
Role and responsibilities
This is your chance to drive real impact. From designing frictionless customer flows to managing strategic global partners, aligning local and global stakeholders, and continuously innovating the proposition for a competitive edge.
Lead a major cross-country implementation
Own the rollout of our embedded insurance project across multiple markets, ensuring delivery quality, consistency, and speed.
Coordinate the implementation prioritisation, roadmap, dependencies, and delivery across local and global teams.
Design outstanding customer experiences
Champion customer-centric design, ensuring shared learnings are applied across markets to create smooth, intuitive, and trustworthy journeys.
Continuously identify opportunities to simplify, enhance, and differentiate the experience.
Manage local and global alignment with stakeholders & strategic partners
Engage and align a diverse set of internal stakeholders across Product, Tech, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Data, and local country teams.
Build and maintain a strategic relationship with our global insurance platform partner, ensuring delivery excellence and innovation.
Bridge business, tech, and risk
Understand the interplay between customer needs, platform capabilities, regulatory requirements, and risk assessments.
Translate complex technical and contractual elements into actionable decisions and clear communication.
Drive innovation and future-proof the proposition
Stay ahead of market trends, regulatory changes, and new technologies.
Bring fresh ideas and new features that keep us competitive across markets.
Solid experience in Insurance Product Management of at least 5 years, experience in embedded insurance preferred
Experience in Agile way of working incustomer journey design,product management, orlarge-scale program delivery.
Strong ability to navigate and influence in complex stakeholder environments.
Affinity withtechnology,CX design,risk assessments, andcontract/partner management.
Confidence in seeing the bigger picture while keeping delivery on track.
A proactive, collaborative mindset — you’re energized by solving complex challenges together.
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. You can find out more about our employment conditionshere.
The benefits of working with us at ING include:
Competitive compensation and benefits package
25–28 vacation days depending on contract hours
Attractive pension scheme
Individual Savings Contribution (BIS), 3.5% of your gross annual salary
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
Want to apply directly?
Upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the “Apply” button.
Please note, multiple interview steps involving various business stakeholders will be part of the selection process.
